title: 8th Sitting of third session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/8/3/2026).

Preliminary debate on a resolution by Galolhu South MP Meekail Ahmed Naseem calling for full disclosure of the agreement between the government and Eagle Hills on the "Rasmaale" project, to gauge members' views on it.
Preliminary debate on the bill to amend the Income Tax Act (Law No. 25/2019), submitted on behalf of the government by Vilufushi MP Hassan Waheed.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was set to start debating a resolution demanding disclosure of the Rasmaale deal with Eagle Hills and a government bill amending the Income Tax Act.
